categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches assumeutxo snapshot activation in validation and bears the Validation label.
categories.rationale: Prevents an assertion crash and subsequent chainstate corruption during assumeutxo snapshot activation. When transactions enter the mempool during the multi-minute `PopulateAndValidateSnapshot` window while `cs_main` is released, `AddChainstate` triggers an assertion failure after snapshot metadata has been committed, crashing `bitcoind` and forcing a full `-reindex` on restart.
